name: document-distribution-service
description: CargoDesk's first extracted microservice — owns EDI transmittal records and outbound Webhook delivery for shipment documents. Called only by the monolith (routes/document-distribution.js), never by the browser directly. Also the first service migrated to Postgres (ARCHITECTURE.md §13, Phase 0) — see lib/db.js. Resolved dependencies (express, pg, @electric-sql/pglite) are hoisted from the repo root's node_modules — no separate install step.
